retainedFailedPortAttempt.cause: The Darwin fixture used SO_ACCEPTCONN, which actual native probing refused with ENOPROTOOPT. It failed before frontend creation. The earlier value-2 hypothesis was disproved and is not evidence.

portFixtureCorrection.review: The helper reads supported TCP_CONNECTION_INFO on the live owned RawConn and requires the SDK-defined listening state 1, exact IPv4 loopback address and selected port. No arbitrary nonzero fallback is admitted. The original scenario body is unchanged. The new regression rejects bound-only, wrong-port and closed owners and admits the exact listening endpoint. Main inspected the complete helper and regression; peer independently compared the unchanged scenario body. No product executable changed.

Peer independently verified unchanged source/tool/private-input pins and the actual resource cleanup receipts.
finalBatch.cleanupReview: All three real fixtures completed normal cleanup: stopped containers and volumes retained, exact empty owned networks removed, unrelated baseline unchanged, no incomplete-cleanup markers. The occupied-port scenario includes recovery after blocker release; it is not a never-created-broker claim.

limits: Nine actual CLI scenarios passed across separate frozen dirty-source runs. These records are not a canonical six-test collector run, clean committed-candidate qualification or phase acceptance.
Only the port fixture file changed between the cold/remaining-five snapshots and the final batch. Retention of unchanged scenarios is a source-correspondence claim, not fabricated rerun evidence.
